CypherQuery: MATCH (g:UcoexGROUPS)-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESSOFTWARE]->(s:UcoexSOFTWARE) WITH g, count(s) AS softwareCount MATCH (g_fin7:UcoexGROUPS {ucoexNAME: 'FIN7'})-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESSOFTWARE]->(s_fin7:UcoexSOFTWARE) WITH g, softwareCount, count(s_fin7) AS fin7SoftwareCount WHERE softwareCount > fin7SoftwareCount RETURN g.ucoexNAME, softwareCount
CypherToQuestion: Which groups use more software tools than 'FIN7'?

NaturalLanguageQuestion: Rank CVEs by severity (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).
CypherQuery: MATCH (c:UcoCVE) RETURN c.label, c.ucobaseSeverity ORDER BY CASE c.ucobaseSeverity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END LIMIT 50
CypherToQuestion: Show me 50 CVEs, ranked by severity.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: Find software used by 'APT28' that was NOT used in the 'SolarWinds Orion' campaign.
CypherQuery: MATCH (g:UcoexGROUPS {ucoexNAME: 'APT28'})-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESSOFTWARE]->(s:UcoexSOFTWARE) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (c:UcoexCAMPAIGNS {ucoexNAME: 'SolarWinds Orion'})-[:UCOEXCAMPAIGNUSESSOFTWARE]->(s) } RETURN s.ucoexNAME
CypherToQuestion: Find software used by 'APT28' that was *not* used in the 'SolarWinds Orion' campaign.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: Find all groups that use at least one technique.
CypherQuery: MATCH (g:UcoexGROUPS) WHERE EXISTS { (g)-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESTECHNIQUE]->(:UcoexMITREATTACK) } RETURN g.ucoexNAME
CypherToQuestion: Find all groups that use at least one attack technique.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: (Union) List all techniques used by 'Lazarus Group' OR associated with 'Mimikatz' software.
CypherQuery: MATCH (t:UcoexMITREATTACK) WHERE EXISTS { (:UcoexGROUPS {ucoexNAME: 'Lazarus Group'})-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESTECHNIQUE]->(t) } OR EXISTS { (:UcoexSOFTWARE {ucoexNAME: 'Mimikatz'})-[:UCOEXSOFTWAREUSESTECHNIQUE]->(t) } RETURN t.ucoexNAME
CypherToQuestion: List all techniques used by 'Lazarus Group' OR 'Mimikatz'.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: List all exploit targets that have a vulnerability but NO associated weakness (CWE).
CypherQuery: MATCH (et:UcoExploitTarget) WHERE EXISTS { (et)-[:UCOHASVULNERABILITY]->(:UcoVulnerability) } AND NOT EXISTS { (et)-[:UCOHASWEAKNESS]->(:UcoCWE) } RETURN et.uri
CypherToQuestion: List exploit targets that have a vulnerability but NO associated weakness (CWE).

NaturalLanguageQuestion: (Union) List all groups OR software associated with the 'SolarWinds Orion' campaign.
CypherQuery: MATCH (n) WHERE EXISTS { (:UcoexCAMPAIGNS {ucoexNAME: 'SolarWinds Orion'})-[:UCOEXATTRIBUTEDTO]->(n) } OR EXISTS { (:UcoexCAMPAIGNS {ucoexNAME: 'SolarWinds Orion'})-[:UCOEXCAMPAIGNUSESSOFTWARE]->(n) } RETURN n.ucoexNAME
CypherToQuestion: List all groups and software associated with the 'SolarWinds Orion' campaign.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: (Intersection) Find CVEs that are 'CRITICAL' AND have an observed example.
CypherQuery: MATCH (c:UcoCVE {ucobaseSeverity: 'CRITICAL'}) WHERE EXISTS { (c)<-[:UCOEXEXAMPLEOBSERVEDIN]-(:UcoexObservedExample) } RETURN c.label
CypherToQuestion: Find 'CRITICAL' CVEs that *also* have a real-world observed example.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: List all mitigations that do NOT mitigate any known technique.
CypherQuery: MATCH (m:UcoexMITIGATIONS) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (m)-[:UCOEXMITIGATES]->(:UcoexMITREATTACK) } RETURN m.ucoexNAME
CypherToQuestion: List all mitigations that do *not* counter any known technique.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: (Union) List all CVEs from 2023 OR with 'HIGH' impact score.
CypherQuery: MATCH (c:UcoCVE) MATCH (v:UcoVulnerability)-[:UCOHASCVE_ID]->(c) WHERE v.ucopublishedDateTime STARTS WITH '2023' OR c.ucoimpactScore = 'HIGH' RETURN DISTINCT c.label
CypherToQuestion: List all CVEs from 2023 OR with a 'HIGH' impact score.

NaturalLanguageQuestion: (Intersection) Find software used by 'FIN7' AND 'Lazarus Group' AND 'APT28'.
CypherQuery: MATCH (g1:UcoexGROUPS {ucoexNAME: 'FIN7'})-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESSOFTWARE]->(s:UcoexSOFTWARE)<-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESSOFTWARE]-(g2:UcoexGROUPS {ucoexNAME: 'Lazarus Group'}) MATCH (g3:UcoexGROUPS {ucoexNAME: 'APT28'})-[:UCOEXGROUPUSESSOFTWARE]->(s) RETURN s.ucoexNAME
CypherToQuestion: What software is used by 'FIN7' AND 'Lazarus Group' AND 'APT28'?

NaturalLanguageQuestion: (Difference) List all 'Enterprise' techniques NOT mitigated by any 'UcoexMITIGATIONS'.
CypherQuery: MATCH (t:UcoexMITREATTACK {ucoexDOMAIN: 'Enterprise'}) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (t)<-[:UCOEXMITIGATES]-(:UcoexMITIGATIONS) } RETURN t.ucoexNAME
CypherToQuestion: List 'Enterprise' techniques that are *not* mitigated by anything.
